Healthcare AI Enterprise Sales Executive New Logo Acquisition | Healthcare AI & Cloud Transformation Rackspace Technology is building the next generation of healthcare AI infrastructure — and we’re hiring a proven enterprise hunter to lead new logo growth across U.S. health systems and IDNs.

This is a pure acquisition role focused on winning new enterprise healthcare customers navigating AI adoption, cloud modernization, data transformation, and operational automation.

You’ll partner with AWS, Microsoft, Google Cloud, and Palantir to bring transformative AI, cloud, and data solutions to some of the largest healthcare organizations in the country.

If you thrive in complex enterprise sales, enjoy building territory from scratch, and want to capitalize on the explosive healthcare AI market, this is a high-impact opportunity with significant earnings upside.

What You’ll Own Build and close a pipeline of net-new healthcare enterprise opportunities Sell complex AI, cloud, data, and managed services solutions into health systems and IDNs Engage CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CMOs, and executive healthcare leadership Drive full-cycle enterprise sales from prospecting through close Lead strategic multi-stakeholder deals ranging from $500K–$5M+ ACV Partner closely with AWS, Azure, GCP, and Palantir field teams Position Rackspace as a trusted healthcare AI transformation partner What You’ll Sell AI/ML infrastructure and GPU environments Managed multi-cloud solutions (AWS, Azure, GCP) Data and analytics platforms HIPAA-compliant security and governance Healthcare AI modernization solutions Palantir Foundry and AIP solutions What We’re Looking For Required Experience 8+ years enterprise technology sales experience Proven success in net-new logo acquisition Experience selling into healthcare providers, IDNs, or health systems Track record closing complex enterprise deals ($500K–$5M+) Strong executive presence and consultative selling skills Experience with cloud, AI, data, analytics, or infrastructure solutions Preferred Experience Existing healthcare executive relationships Experience with AWS, Azure, GCP, Snowflake, Databricks, or Palantir ecosystems Healthcare AI or digital transformation sales experience Understanding of healthcare data and interoperability environments Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several geographic markets.

The compensation range for this position ranges from $192,610.00/year in our lowest geographic market up to 338,993.60 USD/year in our highest geographic market. Pay is based on a number of factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. The compensation package may also include incentive compensation opportunities in the form of annual bonus or incentives, equity awards and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP). Learn more about benefits at Rackspace.

About Rackspace Technology We are the multicloud solutions experts. We combine our expertise with the world’s leading technologies — across applications, data and security — to deliver end-to-end solutions.

We have a proven record of advising customers based on their business challenges, designing solutions that scale, building and managing those solutions, and optimizing returns into the future. Named a best place to work, year after year according to Fortune, Forbes and Glassdoor, we attract and develop world-class talent.

Join us on our mission to embrace technology, empower customers and deliver the future. More on Rackspace Technology Though we’re all different, Rackers thrive through our connection to a central goal: to be a valued member of a winning team on an inspiring mission. And we embrace the notion that unique perspectives fuel innovation and enable us to best serve our customers and communities around the globe.

We welcome you to apply today and want you to know that we are committed to offering equal employment opportunity without regard to age, color, disability, gender reassignment or identity or expression, genetic information, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity status, military or veteran status, nationality, ethnic or national origin, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any legally protected characteristic.

The Opportunity This position is a remote opportunity in the Abbott Diabetes Care Division. We are helping people with Diabetes lead healthier, happier lives. As a global leader in diabetes care, Abbott is constantly working to deliver the highest quality products and unwavering support to our customers.

Consistent and accurate glucose monitoring is the foundation of any diabetes management plan, so we’re committed to continuous improvement in the way patients and professionals measure, track and analyze glucose levels.

As a Diabetes Sales Associate, you will be responsible for growing sales with HCPs assigned to the territory by developing customer relationships, being an ambassador for Abbott ’s FreeStyle products, and strengthening overall market presence.

This role is instrumental in delivery of sales and profitability objectives, as well as expanding brand reputation. This is a field-sales opportunity. What You'll Do
Meeting or exceeding sales quotas/objectives for FreeStyle Libre portfolio.
Leverage company generated targets to prospect for new business and close for new sales in expanded marketplace.
Collaborate with various channels partners within HCP, Managed Care, Retail, and Point of Care organizations.
Establish strong relationships with a broad base of internal and external health care constituents (e.g., physicians, nurses, pharmacists, CDEs, etc.).
Act with a sense of purpose and urgency, engaging in a friendly, respectful manner. Focus on the needs and interest of others, while motivating change.
Keep current on internal and competitive products and position by utilizing a variety of resources.
Develop proficiency in the Company’s sales model to ensure product adoption and utilization along the buying cycle.
Understand and convey information professionally and accurately.
Develop business plans based on current trends and goals that include short and long-term actions.
Keep current in market trends and competitor’s strategy.
Deliver sales results as ass,igned in primary care market, focusing on driving broad awareness and education of CGM and the FreeStyle Libre brand. Deliver sales results within endocrinology market as assigned.
Position products and services using appropriate resources using confident, convincing logic.
Tailor sales approach to meet customer needs by utilizing appropriate resources.
Handle objections and explore perspectives and tactfully address them.
Develop and implement plans (e.g., territory, account and call) that include goals, action plans, time frames and resources.
Convey information clearly and concisely. Respond to others and listen carefully to understand the message.
Regularly track and report progress against plan. Redirect efforts as necessary.
Complete all administrative tasks accurately and in a timely fashion.
Document daily, weekly and monthly activities utilizing call reporting / tracking system.
Maintain accountability for all samples in accordance with Division guidelines.
Work within quality guidelines established for compliance.
Implement and maintain the effectiveness of the quality system.
This role covers the territory from Columbus - Mount Vernon - Zanesville - Logan - New Albany.
Experience You'll Bring Required

Wir bei SoSafe haben das Ziel, der führende Anbieter für Human Risk Management Lösungen in Europa zu werden. Über uns
Wir bei SoSafe haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, die digitale Welt sicherer zu gestalten, indem wir den menschlichen Faktor in der Cybersicherheit in den Mittelpunkt stellen.
Als eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Security-Awareness-Scale-ups weltweit nutzen wir verhaltenswissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse und datengesteuertes Lernen, um Menschen effektiv gegen Cyber-Bedrohungen zu stärken. Unser Human Risk Management-Ansatz unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, ihre Mitarbeiter*innen zum wirkungsvollsten Schutzschild gegen Sicherheitsrisiken zu entwickeln.
Mit der Unterstützung führender VCs wie Highland Europe und Global Founders Capital expandieren wir weltweit in rasantem Tempo. Wir suchen Teamplayer, die sinnvolle Veränderungen im Bereich Cybersicherheit vorantreiben, Verantwortung übernehmen und gemeinsam mit uns wachsen wollen.
Wenn du in einem lebendigen, zielorientierten Umfeld aufblühst, das Innovation, Vielfalt und Zusammenarbeit großschreibt – dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

About Zeit AI
Zeit AI builds ZeitMind, the agent framework for business intelligence. We connect to the systems companies already run (ERP exports, CRM data, spreadsheets, internal databases) and put agents on top so operators get reliable answers without hiring a data team. Founded by Marvin and Leopold (both ex-Palantir), YC S24, backed by Oxford Seed Fund and Sequoia Scout. Customers across manufacturing, agriculture, and aviation. $1M+ ARR in year one and doubling every six months.
What this role is
As a Business Development Representative, you'll help drive our growth by building our outbound sales engine and creating new customer opportunities.
Cold calling is how we won our first customers, and it's still our strongest channel.
You'll be the first point of contact for prospects: identifying pain points, generating leads, and converting interest into real opportunities. Within weeks, you'll run your own discovery calls and define use cases directly with C-level prospects.
This role is a fast track into sales.
Outbound experience? You'll move to (Junior) AE in 3-6 months.
New to sales? Same path - your ramp speed sets the pace.
We invest in you with daily coaching, clear targets, uncapped upside. You won't be handed a list and left alone we grow together.

Outbound Execution: Run high-velocity outbound with cold calling as your primary channel, backed by email and LinkedIn cadences where they add value
Qualification: Assess real pain, urgency, budget, and the right stakeholders before booking a meeting

## Where passion meets opportunity ##
The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!
## Your Purpose ##
MSC Cruises, the world-s third largest cruise line, is expanding its Talent Acquisition function in support of its continued growth in the US market. We are hiring a Talent Acquisition Manager to lead hiring for high-impact, business-critical, and leadership-level roles across the organization.

This role requires deep full-cycle recruiting experience, a strong track record of improving recruiting processes, and a thoughtful, data-driven approach to talent strategy.

This person will serve as a trusted partner to senior leaders and play a key role in attracting and securing exceptional talent for some of the company-s most important hires. **This role is based within commuting distance of downtown Miami and requires 4 days per week in office.**

* Manage the end-to-end recruitment process for critical roles across the business, including high-profile leadership positions.
* Build strong relationships with hiring managers and senior leaders, serving as a trusted Talent Acquisition partner and advisor.
* Partner closely with hiring managers to understand talent needs, shape job descriptions, and develop effective recruiting strategies. Provide data-driven recommendations on how to attract and assess top talent.
* Use recruiting metrics and analytics to track key performance indicators such as time-to-fill, quality of hire, source of hire, and candidate conversion rates.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition and HR leadership to streamline and optimize hiring processes.
* Develop and execute creative sourcing strategies to build strong pipelines of qualified candidates. Leverage a mix of traditional and innovative sourcing channels, including social media, job boards, employee referrals, networking, and direct outreach, while using data to refine strategy and improve results.
* Conduct proactive talent mapping, market research, and competitive benchmarking to inform search strategy and stay ahead of industry trends, compensation benchmarks, and competitor hiring practices.
* Lead in-depth candidate screening and interview processes to assess qualifications, leadership capabilities, and overall fit.
* Leverage data and feedback to optimize candidate engagement, reduce time-to-hire, and enhance the overall candidate experience.
* Lead the offer process by advising hiring managers on compensation, negotiating complex offers with senior candidates, and ensuring a smooth transition from offer acceptance through onboarding.
* Ensure a positive, transparent, and professional experience for candidates throughout the hiring process. Provide timely feedback and keep candidates informed at every stage.
## Your Journey so far ##
* 8+ years of full-cycle recruiting and/or executive recruitment experience, with a strong track record of hiring for complex, business-critical, and leadership-level roles from manager through SVP.
* Significant in-house recruiting experience within a high-growth, large-scale, or fast-paced environment, with proven success leading searches across functions such as sales, marketing, procurement, IT, and other strategic corporate areas.
* Demonstrated ability to leverage recruiting data and analytics to identify trends, generate insights, and improve hiring outcomes. Strong proficiency in Excel and other data analysis tools, with experience using Applicant Tracking Systems and recruitment analytics platforms.
* Deep experience developing targeted sourcing strategies and engaging high-caliber talent through multiple channels, including LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, networking, and direct outreach.
* Strong interviewing and assessment skills, including experience conducting competency-based, behavioral, and situational interviews to evaluate leadership capability, organizational fit, and long-term potential.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex insights in a clear and actionable manner, influence senior stakeholders, and represent the company credibly with candidates.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple high-priority searches simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail and a high bar for candidate quality.
* Experience with Applicant Tracking Systems such as SuccessFactors, Workday, or Greenhouse, as well as recruiting analytics platforms such as LinkedIn Talent Insights, Google Analytics, or similar performance-tracking tools.

* US Passport or US Permanent Resident

Business Development Representative
Turn strong, growing inbound demand into qualified pipeline — supported by targeted ABX outbound and the industry’s biggest events
There are a lot of security companies out there, but no one is doing what Nucleus is doing: giving security teams the ability to run the most effective vulnerability and exposure management program possible. Some of the largest enterprises and government agencies in the world run on our platform, and we’re growing fast. Top-tier venture funding, an amazing team who will fight beside you to accomplish the impossible, great benefits, and fully remote.
Here’s the good news about this seat: our inbound demand is strong and growing. Your primary job is to work it well — respond fast, qualify sharply, and turn real interest into meetings your AE counterparts are glad to take. You’ll back that up with targeted outbound into named accounts as part of our account-based (ABX) program, and you’ll represent Nucleus face to face at the industry’s biggest security events a few times a year.
Why this role exists
This is a new seat created by growth — driven in large part by inbound volume we want to convert better and faster. Your individual output is visible and it matters. You’ll also be joining a leader whose real strength is developing top-performing BDRs: structured onboarding, weekly coaching and mock calls, and a documented track record of promoting reps into account executive, solutions engineering, customer success, and marketing roles.

Own inbound — this is the priority. Be the first, fast, credible response to the people raising their hands: demo requests, content and webinar leads, event follow-up, and trial interest. Qualify with real discovery — need, timing, environment, decision process — and convert genuine interest into meetings that stick. Speed and judgment both matter: our buyers are busy, and the first good conversation usually wins.
Support the ABX program with targeted outbound. Outbound here is deliberate, not a numbers game. You’ll work a defined set of high-value named accounts alongside Marketing and your AEs — using intent and account signals to time your outreach — so outbound reinforces the accounts we’ve collectively decided matter most.
Personalize everything, and use AI to do it well. Our buyers are technical and busy. You’ll write outreach and follow-up that sounds like a person who understands their world — and you’ll use AI tools (Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) every day to research faster and sharpen your messaging.
Run a clean process. Manage inbound routing, accounts, and follow-up in Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Outreach, and Gong — and partner closely with your AEs and Marketing to act on campaign signals fast.
Represent Nucleus at our biggest events. A few times a year, our BDRs are the front line at RSAC, Black Hat, the Gartner Security & Risk Management Summit, and other key events — proactively engaging people in and around our booth, qualifying on the spot, and booking high-quality meetings. Expect roughly 3–4 events a year, plus our annual company and sales kickoff.
Your first 90 days
We’ve run this playbook before, and we don’t leave ramp to chance:
First 30 days
By 60 days
By 90 days
Structured onboarding and product training. Learn our market, ICP, and the vulnerability and exposure management problems our buyers face. Shadow calls, run mock calls, and start handling live inbound with close coaching.
Owning inbound response and qualification for your patch, with outbound sequences live into your named ABX accounts. Weekly 1:1s and email-writing sessions to sharpen your craft.
Fully ramped and holding your own number — converting inbound into qualified meetings, supporting ABX outbound, and confident enough in the material to represent Nucleus in front of a security buyer.

2–4+ years in sales or business development — BDR/SDR, inside sales, or another customer-facing role. Experience handling real inbound volume with a high qualification bar is especially relevant.
Sharp qualification instincts. You can tell a genuine opportunity from a tire-kicker quickly, and you protect your AEs’ calendars without dropping real interest on the floor.
Outbound capability too. You can build and run a thoughtful, targeted sequence into a named account when it matters — not just work a queue.
Cybersecurity or technical SaaS experience preferred. Holding a credible conversation with a security buyer is a meaningful advantage.
Strong communication. Concise and credible in writing and on the phone with senior technical people.
Comfortable in person. You genuinely enjoy meeting people face to face and can open a conversation with a stranger on a busy expo floor.
AI-fluent. Using AI tools such as Copilot, ChatGPT, and Claude in your daily workflow is a requirement, not a bonus.
Tech-savvy. Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Gong, Slack, Teams, and Zoom.
Curious, resilient, and coachable. You want to be coached — this is a team where you’ll get real feedback and be expected to use it.
Nice to have: selling into U.S. Federal, Defense, or State & Local government; an established cybersecurity network; a bachelor’s or associate degree.
If you have less experience than the range above but can show real results and genuine curiosity about security, we’d still like to hear from you. We hire for trajectory and coachability, not just years on a resume.
Why you should be excited
The mission. We automate enterprise vulnerability and exposure management so security teams can prioritize and mitigate risk, at scale — working toward a world where remediation outpaces exploitation.
Warm demand to work with. You’re not starting from zero. Inbound interest is real and growing, and your job is to make the most of it.
The career path. A launchpad, run by a leader who builds and promotes top performers into AE, solutions engineering, customer success, and marketing roles.
Nucleus believes “work is people”, and when our people succeed, our company succeeds.

Vertriebs-Mindset und Kommunikations-Talent?Wir glauben nicht an stumpfes „Cold Calling“ nach Schema F. Denn die Realität im modernen B2B-Vertrieb ist: Jeder Mensch kommuniziert anders.

Der eine HR-Entscheider greift am liebsten direkt zum Hörer, die nächste filtert ihre Prioritäten morgens per E-Mail, und wieder jemand anderes ist am besten über eine gezielte Nachricht auf LinkedIn erreichbar. Deine Kunst liegt darin, für die richtige Person den genau passenden Kanal zu wählen, echtes Interesse zu wecken und die Brücke zu bauen.
Deine Aufgaben
Identifikation und Marktanalyse: Du recherchierst eigenständig nach potenziellen Neukunden (B2B) und identifizierst die relevanten HR-Entscheider und Geschäftsführer in verschiedenen Zielmärkten. Du analysierst Branchen-Trends, um deine Ansprache maßzuschneidern.

Erstkontakt und Lead-Qualifizierung: Du sprichst potenzielle Kunden proaktiv über verschiedene Kanäle (Telefon, E-Mail, LinkedIn/Social Selling) an. Mit den richtigen Fragen findest du im Erstgespräch heraus, wo der Schuh drückt, und qualifizierst die Leads hinsichtlich ihres Bedarfs und Potenzials.
Beziehungsaufbau und Terminierung: Du begeisterst HR-Verantwortliche von unserer innovativen HR-Software und vereinbarst qualifizierte Demo-Termine für unsere Account Executives. Du bist die „Visitenkarte“ von HRpuls und baust die erste vertrauensvolle Brücke zu unseren Kunden.
Pipeline-Management und Optimierung: Du pflegst unser CRM-System gewissenhaft und hältst deine Sales-Pipeline stets aktuell. Du optimierst deine Ansprache-Strategien kontinuierlich im Team, um die Effizienz und Conversion-Rate zu steigern.
Welche Qualifikation benötigst Du?
Vertriebsaffinität: Erste Erfahrung im Vertrieb, Telesales, Account Management oder der Kundenbetreuung – idealerweise im B2B- oder SaaS-Umfeld – ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Quereinsteiger mit der richtigen Einstellung sind herzlich willkommen!
Kommunikationsstärke: Du hast eine positive Ausstrahlung am Telefon, bist redegewandt, kannst aktiv zuhören und lässt dich von einem „Nein“ nicht entmutigen.
Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du organisierst deine Aufgaben und Leads selbstständig, arbeitest zielorientiert und behältst im CRM stets den Überblick.
Technische Affinität: Erfahrung mit modernen Software-Tools (z. B. Office, CRM-Systeme, SaaS) und ein Interesse an HR- und Softwarelösungen.
Lernbereitschaft: Du hast Lust, dich fachlich und methodisch im Tech-Vertrieb weiterzuentwickeln, und möchtest ein echter Experte in der Neukundenansprache werden.
Warum HRpuls?
Wachstum & Entwicklung: Unser kontinuierliches Wachstum bietet Dir die beste Grundlage für Deine persönliche, methodische und fachliche Entwicklung.
Weiterentwicklung: Bei uns hast Du die Chance, Deine Karriere aktiv zu gestalten.
Kreativer Freiraum: Wir lieben frische Ideen und setzen sie schnell um. Du wirst Teil eines Teams sein, das Innovation schätzt und ermutigt, Neues auszuprobieren. Fehler sind für uns kein Problem, sondern die Grundlage für Verbesserungen.
Team & Werte: Unser Team ist bunt und vielfältig, aber uns verbinden gemeinsame Werte, die auf unserer Website zu finden sind. Bei uns wirst Du Dich schnell als Teil einer starken Gemeinschaft fühlen.
Flexibel und ortsunabhängig: Als Remote-First-Unternehmen kannst Du vollständig ortsunabhängig arbeiten. Workations sind bei uns Standard. So gestaltest Du Deinen Arbeitsalltag flexibel, während Du gleichzeitig Teil unseres dynamischen Teams bleibst.

s.h: Bewirb dich, wenn du Folgendes mitbringst
s.t:
Du hast kein Problem damit, an klaren KPIs und Terminquoten gemessen zu werden – im Gegenteil, du willst Erfolg sehen und das Wachstum von HRpuls aktiv vorantreiben. Du besitzt eine gesunde Portion Hartnäckigkeit, Biss und hast Spaß daran, täglich neue Menschen von einer smarten Lösung zu begeistern.

Du möchtest die absolute Basis des B2B-Vertriebs von der Pike auf lernen und dich in einem dynamischen SaaS-Umfeld weiterentwickeln. Du brennst für Software, HR-Prozesse und digitale Lösungen und willst ein wichtiger Teil unserer Sales-Engine werden.

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.
Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.
We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

s.h: What It’s Like to Work at YipitData
s.t:
YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.
From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention
If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm— YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

With over 500+ fundamental investor clients, we are now expanding our footprint into the quantitative investment space. We’re launching new data feeds tailored to systematic strategies and we are seeking a Senior Sales Executive to lead our growth in this vertical. This individual will play a pivotal role in introducing YipitData ’s alternative data feed products to quantitative hedge funds and other systematic investment firms.
You will own the full sales cycle — from identifying and qualifying leads to closing deals. This is primarily a new business (hunting) role, ideal for someone who thrives on building new relationships and breaking into complex, data-driven markets.

Act as a primary driver of revenue growth by selling YipitData ’s feed products into quantitative and systematic investment funds.
Build and maintain a strong pipeline of opportunities through proactive outreach and your existing network.
Collaborate with internal product teams to tailor solutions that address clients’ specific data needs.
Manage the complete sales process — from prospecting to contract execution — ensuring exceptional client experience.
Represent YipitData at relevant conferences, industry events, and client meetings to strengthen our presence in the quant community.

s.h: You Are Likely to Succeed If You
s.t:
Have 4+ years of experience in financial data sales, with a proven track record selling to quantitative hedge funds or asset managers.
Have a proven track record of exceeding quota and successfully introducing complex or technical data products to new clients.
Leverage your network within the quant and systematic community to build pipeline
Are resourceful, resilient, and energized by the challenge of opening new doors.
Thrive in a collaborative environment and are motivated by team and company success, not just individual achievement.

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary:
We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, flexible vacation, a generous 401K match, parental leave, team events, wellness budget, learning reimbursement, and more!
Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or oﬃce politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.

Un produit qui tient ses promesses : la démo fait le travail. Vos prospects voient la différence en une session, pas après six mois de POC.
Un marché en forte demande : tous les cabinets français cherchent une réponse à l'IA, et les usages ne sont pas encore stabilisés.
Une équipe qui se construit : vous entrez tôt et vous pesez sur la façon dont on vend.

6 à 12 mois d'expérience en vente outbound B2B SaaS, ou un vrai track record de SDR top performer. Le poste reste ouvert aux profils en début de carrière qui ont l'énergie, la discipline et la "faim" commerciale.

About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

As an Enterprise Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will drive business growth by identifying opportunities with target clients. You’ll play a pivotal role in identifying potential customers, generating new business opportunities, and providing support to both customers and our team.

You will set the stage for successful sales interactions through cold outreach efforts and nurturing relationships to secure qualified meetings for our sales team. If you’re a self-motivated individual with a passion for sales, we encourage you to join our team!
This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
Sales: Understand current and future demand. Enable, educate, and directly support the sales force to best position this practice with Toptal clients and win new business. Lead client conversations, presenting Toptal ’s perspective on innovation and experience topics, and ask exploratory questions to better understand client needs.
Begin the Relationship: Through lead-generation activities and cold-calling, you will prospect, educate, qualify, and develop sales-ready leads and opportunities from unsigned clients and accounts. You will enthusiastically explain Toptal ’s vision, pinpoint opportunities, and generate interest.
Client and Industry Knowledge: Clients are at the heart of everything we do. As the first point of contact for future Enterprise clients, you will be building rapport through strategic outreach and a well-rounded client and industry knowledge. Researching clients and staying informed on industry trends will be key to your success.
Collaborate with Team Members: You will collaborate with your team and Sales Executives to pursue opportunities, recommend appropriate follow-up actions, and schedule qualified meetings. Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.
Growth and Development: Our team has an aversion to complacency. We are always looking to improve both individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical success factors in this role and at Toptal . As you become more comfortable in the role, you will help evolve our demand generation strategy and tactics.

s.h: In the first week, expect to
s.t:
Onboard and integrate into Toptal .
Learn Toptal ’s model, our value proposition, and our story.
Work with cross-functional teams to understand how you can utilize our incredible global team to build client relationships and drive success.
Learn the breadth of Toptal ’s impact on the world’s largest companies.
Grasp the importance of the SDR function to the success of Toptal .
Understand our sales method and our selling process to set you up for success.

s.h: In the first month, expect to
s.t:
Complete our personalized sales training program with mock calls, cold calls, and role-play scenarios.
Learn how to use Salesforce.com (our CRM) and other SaaS outreach tools (ZoomInfo, SalesLoft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).
Integrate into your pod, partner with Enterprise Sales Executives and Client Partners, and begin targeting strategic accounts.
Learn the process for outreach, including calling, emailing, and LinkedIn messaging. Implement an outreach process and hit 1-month objectives.
Learn how to analyze industry drivers, business problems, and target buyers.

s.h: In the first three months, expect to
s.t:
Become fully ramped on the SDR team, attaining your metrics, which include calls, emails, and other sales activities.
Exercising discretion and independent judgment, uncover new opportunities within existing accounts and target accounts that result in revenue-generating engagements for Toptal .
Hit call/email quotas and fully ramped objectives.
Become proficient in using our SaaS tools.
Learn how to maintain excellent data integrity in Salesforce.com.

s.h: In the first six months, expect to
s.t:
Continuously hit fully ramped quotas and objectives.
Assist with training and onboarding new SDRs.
Build new and existing client relationships, expand Toptal ’s partnerships, and continue to execute account plans.
Suggest, implement, and experiment with new lead and demand generation activities.

s.h: In the first year, expect to
s.t:
Have built a portfolio of net new accounts from the strategic account list.
Become a mentor to new members of the team, helping them learn about Toptal , our model, and how proper sales development practices can improve relationships and increase revenue.
